conventions.affinities: never pooled or paired across affinity/build/machine groups
conventions.growth: observed two doublings, not an asymptotic bound
conventions.q2_wall_ms: front plus census and callback; excludes caller preprocessing
conventions.ratio_null: missing observation or zero denominator; never treated as zero growth
conventions.threads_0: fresh mono reference, not a parallel worker
conventions.threads_1: parallel API with one inline worker
conventions.time_cells: direct timing fields are medians; min_ms/max_ms cover all n_samples
conventions.timing_ratios: same-configuration median ratios on a shared host, not stable speedup claims
conventions.total_ms: probe including preprocessing and owned payload destruction
conventions.work: distinct counter units remain separate; sums of worker intervals are not wall times
